// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// Uno_Mas

//@version=6

// ============================================================================
// VWAP SESSION AND NY CASH (Multi-Session Expansion)
// ============================================================================

indicator("NYVWAP IB Multi-Session", overlay = true, max_labels_count = 500)

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================
const string TIMEZONE = "America/New_York"
transparent = color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100)

// ============================================================================
// USER INPUTS
// ============================================================================

// Calculation Settings
CALC_GROUP = "Calculation"
i_enableHD = input.bool(true, title = "Use 5-min data for precision", group = CALC_GROUP)

// NY Session Settings
NY_GROUP = "NY Session (09:30 - 16:00)"
i_ny_on             = input.bool(true, "Enable NY Session", group = NY_GROUP)
i_NY_color          = input.color(color.new(#4caf50, 0), title = "VWAP Color", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_width          = input.int(1, title = "Width", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_style          = input.string("Solid", title = "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_label          = input.string("NYVWAP", title = "Label", group = NY_GROUP)
i_ny_ib_color       = input.color(color.new(#5b9cf6, 0), "IB Color", group = NY_GROUP)

// Asia Session Settings
ASIA_GROUP = "Asia Session (18:00 - 03:00)"
i_as_on             = input.bool(false, "Enable Asia Session", group = ASIA_GROUP)
i_as_sess           = input.session("1800-0300", "Session Time", group = ASIA_GROUP)
i_as_ib_sess        = input.session("1800-1900", "IB Time", group = ASIA_GROUP)
i_AS_color          = input.color(color.new(#ff9800, 0), title = "VWAP Color", group = ASIA_GROUP, inline = "asv")
i_AS_width          = input.int(1, title = "Width", group = ASIA_GROUP, inline = "asv")
i_AS_style          = input.string("Solid", title = "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = ASIA_GROUP, inline = "asv")
i_AS_label          = input.string("AsiaVWAP", title = "Label", group = ASIA_GROUP)
i_as_ib_color       = input.color(color.new(#ffeb3b, 0), "IB Color", group = ASIA_GROUP)

// London Session Settings
LON_GROUP = "London Session (03:00 - 09:30)"
i_ln_on             = input.bool(false, "Enable London Session", group = LON_GROUP)
i_ln_sess           = input.session("0300-0930", "Session Time", group = LON_GROUP)
i_ln_ib_sess        = input.session("0300-0400", "IB Time", group = LON_GROUP)
i_LN_color          = input.color(color.new(#2196f3, 0), title = "VWAP Color", group = LON_GROUP, inline = "lnv")
i_LN_width          = input.int(1, title = "Width", group = LON_GROUP, inline = "lnv")
i_LN_style          = input.string("Solid", title = "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = LON_GROUP, inline = "lnv")
i_LN_label          = input.string("LonVWAP", title = "Label", group = LON_GROUP)
i_ln_ib_color       = input.color(color.new(#00bcd4, 0), "IB Color", group = LON_GROUP)

// Shared IB & Fib Settings
IB_FIB_GROUP = "IB Fibonacci Levels (Shared)"
i_fibStyle    = input.string("Dotted", "Fib Line Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = IB_FIB_GROUP)
i_showFibLabs = input.bool(true, "Show Fib Labels", group = IB_FIB_GROUP)
i_fibLabType  = input.string("Level", "Label Content", options = ["Level", "Price"], group = IB_FIB_GROUP)
i_openIBLabOffset = input.int(0, "Label Offset", group = IB_FIB_GROUP)

// Fib Slots 1-6
i_f1_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 1", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f1"), i_f1_val = input.float(0.236, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f1"), i_f1_col = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f1")
i_f2_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 2", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f2"), i_f2_val = input.float(0.382, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f2"), i_f2_col = input.color(color.new(#f23645, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f2")
i_f3_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 3", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f3"), i_f3_val = input.float(0.500, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f3"), i_f3_col = input.color(color.new(#4caf50, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f3")
i_f4_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 4", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f4"), i_f4_val = input.float(0.618, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f4"), i_f4_col = input.color(color.new(#2962ff, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f4")
i_f5_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 5", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f5"), i_f5_val = input.float(0.786, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f5"), i_f5_col = input.color(color.new(#9c27b0, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f5")
i_f6_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 6", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f6"), i_f6_val = input.float(1.000, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f6"), i_f6_col = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f6")

// Session VWAP
SESSION_GROUP = "Session VWAP (Full Day)"
i_Session_enabled        = input.bool(true, title = "Enabled", group = SESSION_GROUP)
i_Session_color          = input.color(color.new(#04eb85, 0), title = "Color", group = SESSION_GROUP)
i_Session_width          = input.int(2, title = "Width", group = SESSION_GROUP)
i_Session_style          = input.string("Dashed", title = "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = SESSION_GROUP)

// ============================================================================
// USER DEFINED TYPE
// ============================================================================
type myVWAP
    label lab
    bool isActive = true
    float cumPV = 0.0
    float cumVol = 0.0
    float vwap = na

// ============================================================================
// STATE VARIABLES
// ============================================================================
var myVWAP sessionVWAP = myVWAP.new(label.new(bar_index, 0.0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_Session_color))

var myVWAP nyV1 = myVWAP.new(label.new(bar_index, 0.0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_NY_color))
var myVWAP nyV2 = myVWAP.new(label.new(bar_index, 0.0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_NY_color), isActive = false)

var myVWAP asV1 = myVWAP.new(label.new(bar_index, 0.0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_AS_color))
var myVWAP asV2 = myVWAP.new(label.new(bar_index, 0.0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_AS_color), isActive = false)

var myVWAP lnV1 = myVWAP.new(label.new(bar_index, 0.0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_LN_color))
var myVWAP lnV2 = myVWAP.new(label.new(bar_index, 0.0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_LN_color), isActive = false)

var float nyHigh = na, var float nyLow = na, var float nyOp = na
var float asHigh = na, var float asLow = na, var float asOp = na
var float lnHigh = na, var float lnLow = na, var float lnOp = na

var label[] nyFibLabs = array.new_label(6, na)
var label[] asFibLabs = array.new_label(6, na)
var label[] lnFibLabs = array.new_label(6, na)

if barstate.isfirst
    for i = 0 to 5
        array.set(nyFibLabs, i, label.new(bar_index, 0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, size = size.small))
        array.set(asFibLabs, i, label.new(bar_index, 0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, size = size.small))
        array.set(lnFibLabs, i, label.new(bar_index, 0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, size = size.small))

// ============================================================================
// FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================
resetVWAP(myVWAP v) => v.cumPV := 0.0, v.cumVol := 0.0, v.vwap := na

// ============================================================================
// MAIN LOGIC
// ============================================================================
chartMin = timeframe.in_seconds() / 60
useHD = i_enableHD and timeframe.isintraday and chartMin > 5

var float[] pvNY = array.new_float(0), var float[] volNY = array.new_float(0), var int lastNY = -1
var float[] pvAS = array.new_float(0), var float[] volAS = array.new_float(0), var int lastAS = -1
var float[] pvLN = array.new_float(0), var float[] volLN = array.new_float(0), var int lastLN = -1
float hdNY = na, float hdAS = na, float hdLN = na

if useHD
    [h, v, t] = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "5", [hlc3, volume, time])
    if array.size(h) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(h) - 1
            bt = t.get(i), bh = h.get(i), bv = v.get(i), d = dayofmonth(bt, TIMEZONE), hr = hour(bt, TIMEZONE), m = minute(bt, TIMEZONE)
            if bv > 0
                if hr == 9 and m == 30 and d != lastNY
                    array.clear(pvNY), array.clear(volNY), lastNY := d
                array.push(pvNY, bh * bv), array.push(volNY, bv)
                if hr == 18 and m == 0 and d != lastAS
                    array.clear(pvAS), array.clear(volAS), lastAS := d
                array.push(pvAS, bh * bv), array.push(volAS, bv)
                if hr == 3 and m == 0 and d != lastLN
                    array.clear(pvLN), array.clear(volLN), lastLN := d
                array.push(pvLN, bh * bv), array.push(volLN, bv)
        hdNY := array.sum(volNY) > 0 ? array.sum(pvNY) / array.sum(volNY) : na
        hdAS := array.sum(volAS) > 0 ? array.sum(pvAS) / array.sum(volAS) : na
        hdLN := array.sum(volLN) > 0 ? array.sum(pvLN) / array.sum(volLN) : na

f_process(bool on, string sess, string ibSess, float hdV, myVWAP v1, myVWAP v2, float op, float hi, float lo, label[] labs, string name) =>
    float rOp = op, float rHi = hi, float rLo = lo
    if on
        isOp = not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, TIMEZONE)) and na(time(timeframe.period, sess, TIMEZONE)[1])
        isIB = not na(time(timeframe.period, ibSess, TIMEZONE))
        isInSessPlot = not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, TIMEZONE))
        if isOp
            rOp := open, rHi := high, rLo := low
            if v1.isActive
                v1.isActive := false, v2.isActive := true, v1.lab.set_text(""), resetVWAP(v2)
            else
                v1.isActive := true, v2.isActive := false, v2.lab.set_text(""), resetVWAP(v1)
        else if isIB
            rHi := math.max(nz(rHi, -1e10), high), rLo := math.min(nz(rLo, 1e10), low)
        
        cur = v1.isActive ? v1 : v2
        if useHD and not na(hdV)
            cur.vwap := hdV
        else if cur.isActive
            cur.cumPV += hlc3 * volume, cur.cumVol += volume
            cur.vwap := cur.cumVol > 0 ? cur.cumPV / cur.cumVol : na
        
        cur.lab.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, cur.vwap)
        cur.lab.set_text(isInSessPlot or name == "VWAP" ? name : "")

        if not na(rHi) and not na(rLo)
            r = rHi - rLo
            vals = array.from(i_f1_val, i_f2_val, i_f3_val, i_f4_val, i_f5_val, i_f6_val)
            ons  = array.from(i_f1_on, i_f2_on, i_f3_on, i_f4_on, i_f5_on, i_f6_on)
            cols = array.from(i_f1_col, i_f2_col, i_f3_col, i_f4_col, i_f5_col, i_f6_col)
            for i = 0 to 5
                lev = ons.get(i) ? rLo + r * vals.get(i) : na
                l = labs.get(i)
                if not na(lev) and i_showFibLabs and isInSessPlot
                    l.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, lev), l.set_textcolor(cols.get(i))
                    l.set_text(i_fibLabType == "Level" ? str.tostring(vals.get(i), "#.###") : str.tostring(lev, format.mintick))
                else
                    l.set_text("")
    [rOp, rHi, rLo]

[nyOp_new, nyHi_new, nyLo_new] = f_process(i_ny_on, "0930-1600", "0930-1030", hdNY, nyV1, nyV2, nyOp, nyHigh, nyLow, nyFibLabs, i_NY_label)
nyOp := nyOp_new, nyHigh := nyHi_new, nyLow := nyLo_new

[asOp_new, asHi_new, asLo_new] = f_process(i_as_on, i_as_sess, i_as_ib_sess, hdAS, asV1, asV2, asOp, asHigh, asLow, asFibLabs, i_AS_label)
asOp := asOp_new, asHigh := asHi_new, asLow := asLo_new

[lnOp_new, lnHi_new, lnLow_new] = f_process(i_ln_on, i_ln_sess, i_ln_ib_sess, hdLN, lnV1, lnV2, lnOp, lnHigh, lnLow, lnFibLabs, i_LN_label)
lnOp := lnOp_new, lnHigh := lnHi_new, lnLow := lnLow_new

isNewDay = timeframe.change("1D")
vVal = ta.vwap(hlc3, isNewDay)
if useHD
    vH = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "5", ta.vwap(hlc3, timeframe.change("1D")))
    vVal := array.size(vH) > 0 ? array.last(vH) : na

if i_Session_enabled
    sessionVWAP.vwap := vVal
    sessionVWAP.lab.set_xy(bar_index, vVal), sessionVWAP.lab.set_text("VWAP")

// Visibility Flags for Plots
isNyPlot = not na(time(timeframe.period, "0930-1600", TIMEZONE))
isAsPlot = not na(time(timeframe.period, i_as_sess, TIMEZONE))
isLnPlot = not na(time(timeframe.period, i_ln_sess, TIMEZONE))

// ============================================================================
// PLOTTING
// ============================================================================
f_st(s) => s == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : s == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted

// NY
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyOp : na, "NY Open", color.gray, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = plot.linestyle_dashed)
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyHigh : na, "NY IB High", i_ny_ib_color, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyLow : na, "NY IB Low", i_ny_ib_color, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_ny_on ? (nyV1.isActive ? nyV1.vwap : nyV2.vwap) : na, "NY VWAP", i_NY_color, i_NY_width, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = f_st(i_NY_style))

// Asia
plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asOp : na, "Asia Open", color.gray, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = plot.linestyle_dashed)
plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asHigh : na, "Asia IB High", i_as_ib_color, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asLow : na, "Asia IB Low", i_as_ib_color, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_as_on ? (asV1.isActive ? asV1.vwap : asV2.vwap) : na, "Asia VWAP", i_AS_color, i_AS_width, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = f_st(i_AS_style))

// Lon
plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnOp : na, "Lon Open", color.gray, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = plot.linestyle_dashed)
plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnHigh : na, "Lon IB High", i_ln_ib_color, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnLow : na, "Lon IB Low", i_ln_ib_color, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_ln_on ? (lnV1.isActive ? lnV1.vwap : lnV2.vwap) : na, "Lon VWAP", i_LN_color, i_LN_width, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = f_st(i_LN_style))

// Fib Plots
fS = f_st(i_fibStyle)
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyFibLabs.get(0).get_y() : na, "NY F1", i_f1_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyFibLabs.get(1).get_y() : na, "NY F2", i_f2_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyFibLabs.get(2).get_y() : na, "NY F3", i_f3_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyFibLabs.get(3).get_y() : na, "NY F4", i_f4_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyFibLabs.get(4).get_y() : na, "NY F5", i_f5_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ny_on and isNyPlot ? nyFibLabs.get(5).get_y() : na, "NY F6", i_f6_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)

plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asFibLabs.get(0).get_y() : na, "AS F1", i_f1_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asFibLabs.get(1).get_y() : na, "AS F2", i_f2_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asFibLabs.get(2).get_y() : na, "AS F3", i_f3_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asFibLabs.get(3).get_y() : na, "AS F4", i_f4_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asFibLabs.get(4).get_y() : na, "AS F5", i_f5_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_as_on and isAsPlot ? asFibLabs.get(5).get_y() : na, "AS F6", i_f6_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)

plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnFibLabs.get(0).get_y() : na, "LN F1", i_f1_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnFibLabs.get(1).get_y() : na, "LN F2", i_f2_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnFibLabs.get(2).get_y() : na, "LN F3", i_f3_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnFibLabs.get(3).get_y() : na, "LN F4", i_f4_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnFibLabs.get(4).get_y() : na, "LN F5", i_f5_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)
plot(i_ln_on and isLnPlot ? lnFibLabs.get(5).get_y() : na, "LN F6", i_f6_col, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fS)

plot(i_Session_enabled ? sessionVWAP.vwap : na, "Session VWAP", i_Session_color, i_Session_width, style = plot.style_linebr, linestyle = f_st(i_Session_style))
